docs.title: Documentation
docs.intro: Everything you need to know to get the most out of Polyglot Scribe.
docs.s1b: Create a free account from the Sign in page. Once signed in, you'll land on the Dashboard where you can pick between Live, File, and YouTube transcription.
docs.s2b: Click the Live tab and allow microphone access. Speak normally — words appear in real time. Stop recording to save the transcript to your history.
docs.s3b: Drop an MP3, WAV, M4A, MP4 (or any common audio/video format) into the File tab. Files are processed by ElevenLabs Scribe v2 for accurate, multi-language transcripts.
docs.s4b: Paste any YouTube URL. We extract the audio and transcribe the spoken content directly — captions are not required. Supports videos up to 30 minutes.
docs.s5b: Open any saved transcription and pick a target language: English, Amharic, Afaan Oromo, or Somali. View the original and translated text side-by-side.
docs.s6b: Click the play icon next to any transcript or translation to hear it spoken with a natural voice powered by ElevenLabs multilingual TTS.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.p1: We collect your email address (for authentication), audio you submit for transcription, and the resulting text and translations. We do not sell your data. Audio uploads are processed and discarded after transcription completes.
privacy.p2: Your transcripts and translations are saved to your private history so you can revisit them. Only you can read your own data — row-level security ensures other users cannot access your records.
privacy.p3: Transcription is powered by ElevenLabs Scribe; translation by Lovable AI Gateway. Audio and text are sent to these processors solely to fulfill your request and are subject to their privacy policies.
privacy.p4: You can delete any transcription from your history at any time. To delete your account or request a full data export, contact us at support@polyglotscribe.app.
